displayName: Clinical Trial Registry Search / 临床试验注册检索专家
description: Cross-source search of global clinical-trial registries (ClinicalTrials.gov, CDE/ChiCTR/ISRCTN/DRKS/WHO ICTRP, PubChem), normalizes and aggregates phase/status/sponsor/timeline/competitor landscape into JSON/Markdown for trial planning, de-duplication, control-design benchmarking, and competitive intelligence, with optional pytrials integration for batch CT.gov field retrieval. / 跨源检索全球临床试验注册库（ClinicalTrials.gov、CDE/ChiCTR/ISRCTN/DRKS/WHO ICTRP、PubChem），归一化聚合分期/状态/申办方/时间线/竞品格局，产出 JSON / Markdown，用于立项查重、对照设计与竞品格局分析。可选集成 pytrials 批量拉取 CT.gov 字段。
